champion.builds: THE BEST IVERN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ivern Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Summon Aery as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, as well as Font of Life and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Dream Maker as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Moonstone Renewer. For your last 3 items, you should build Redemption, Ardent Censer and finish with Dawncore. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 56.9% winrate over 534 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ivern Support build would be to take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Glacial Augment as your keystone, Cash Back, Time Warp Tonic and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, and Transcendence with Waterwalking in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Dream Maker, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Moonstone Renewer as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Redemption, Ardent Censer and Vigilant Wardstone. The skill order for this build is E - Q - W. In the current patch, this build has a 52.1% win rate over 71 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Summon Aery as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, and Font of Life with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Malignance as a third item. You want to finish the build with Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Liandry's Torment and Dawncore. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 46.3% win rate across 54 matches played. Situational Ivern Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ivern build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ivern runes page.
